rules.description: Project-scoped business rows must have project_id.
Company-scoped business rows must have company_id.
Progress values must stay within 0..100.
Task actual start/end dates must be controlled by task lifecycle services, not external knowledge or candidate asset writes.
project_daily_snapshot should have at most one row per project/date.
Snapshot fact rows must include snapshot_date.
Business baseline rows must include a durable baseline_version; draft/revising working-copy rows may keep version null until confirmed.
Published baseline task rows must include planned start and planned end dates.
Monthly plan rows must include the governed month or planning period.
Monthly plan rows must include an explicit workflow status.
Monthly plan item rows must reference their parent monthly plan or monthly plan version.
Monthly plan item rows must include either a task reference or a durable work item title.
Dependency rows must include predecessor and successor task endpoints.
Dependency rows must not point a task to itself.
Duration experience samples must include a governed source type or source reference.
Duration experience sample durations must be zero or positive.
Duration experience samples must include an explicit sample status.
External knowledge source rows must include a durable source_key.
External knowledge sources need a URL or durable source locator.
External knowledge sources must carry an explicit trust_level before candidate review.
Downloaded external source artifacts must have a content hash.
External knowledge sources must carry an explicit governance_status.
External knowledge documents must include a durable document_key.
External knowledge documents must include a governed document_type.
External knowledge documents must include extraction_status for OCR/table review governance.
